attr.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
attr.desc: Open-world action-driving game based on the 2003 PC/console release, built from the leaked source code. Requires your own legally-owned copy of the PC release's game data - see README.md.
attr.inst: Copy the PC installation's data (the art, movies, sound, scripts folders and the .rcf files, using the original .rmv movie files rather than converted .bk2 ones) into simpsonshitandrun/ before first launch.
